events.name: Bash
events.head: Check remote, node cap, run check-guides
events.input: $ git remote -v | head -2 && grep -n -i "node\|14" app/scripts/check-guides.mjs | head -30 && (cd app && node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for node cap in check-guides
events.input: $ grep -n -i "nodes\|cap\|> *1[0-9]" app/scripts/check-guides.mjs | head; git log --oneline -3 -- app/scripts/check-guides.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find where 14-node cap lives
events.input: $ grep -rn "14" app/src/lib/guides/*.ts app/src/content/guides/schema.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -i "node\|flow" | head; git log --all --oneline -S"17 nodes" | head -3; grep -rln "check-guides" app/package.json app/scripts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Trace the s5-pipeline failure source
events.input: $ grep -rn "nodes" app/scripts/check-guides.mjs app/src/lib/guides/validate*.ts app/src/lib/guides/journey-check.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "check-guides" app/scripts/run-chain.sh; git show 6168a3aa --stat | head -20; git log -1 --format=%B 6168a3aa | grep -o "check-guides[^.]*\."

events.text: The guard is already fixed: check-guides passes on main, and the cap in `validate.ts` is already 18. Next I'll find out where that change came from and rerun the other checks.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find cap commit; run probes and tsc
events.input: $ git log --oneline -S"more than 18 nodes" -- app/src/lib/guides/validate.ts | head -3; sed -n 95p app/src/lib/guides/schema.ts; cd app && (node scripts/probe-flows.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3); (node scripts/probe-details.mjs - - 2>&1 | grep -c "merge-span"; node scripts/probe-details.mjs - - 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|WARN" | head -5); npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | grep -c "error TS"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check cap commit is on origin/main
events.input: $ git branch -r --contains 12a53067 | head -3; git show 12a53067 --stat | tail -3; sed -n 30,37p app/src/lib/guides/validate.ts

events.text: The cap change is already on origin/main (12a53067, from T-255), so nothing needs pushing. I'll fix the stale "≤ 14" doc comment in the schema so it matches the guard.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Commit, update T-130 and T-254, ack note
events.input: $ git add -- app/src/lib/guides/schema.ts && git commit -q -m "Agent T-130: schema doc comment matches the 18-node chart cap in validate.ts
